# Passphrase generator

Canonical page: https://nepocore.com/tools/passphrase/

Generate a random multiword passphrase using a bundled word list. This browser tool shows the inputs, assumptions and resulting output so you can use it for a specific everyday task.

## How to use it

1. Enter your own values or choose a supported file.
2. Adjust the options and run the tool.
3. Review the result, then copy, export or save it when available.

## Example

Generate six random words with a chosen separator and optionally append a number.

## Limits and checks

Randomness comes from the browser’s cryptographic generator. Security depends on the word list, length and keeping the result private.

## Access and processing

Free to use without an account. Interactive processing requires JavaScript in a modern browser. Input is processed in the browser rather than sent to a processing server. Optional browser storage is not a synchronized account.

## Method and sources

- [EFF — short word list and passphrase guidance](https://www.eff.org/dice)
